integrity: Exact integer arithmetic certificates and a standalone verifier are embedded. The finite verifier supports the explicit seeds and sample lifts; the infinite theorem uses algebraic scaling identities and a published upper bound.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the specified divisibility subfamilies only, not every even nonzero off-diagonal parameter. Constructions include singular matrices; the nine-element upper bound relies on Franušić–Pejković Theorem 4.2. Unindexed prior equivalences remain possible. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Nine-element nondegenerate Jordan Diophantine sets for two infinite congruence families
